company.shortDescription: SaaS, Customer Expereince, Employee Expereince, Market Research, Data Analytics
company.description: At Hoick, we empower businesses to listen to customer and employee feedback, understand and analyze what they hear, and take action to improve experiences and design new ones. We help organizations capture and act on customer, market, product, brand, and employee insights all in one place. Hoick's family of products and services also includes Borrow our Brain, a strategy practice that helps leaders understand, envision, and articulate data as a strategy. By leveraging data as a powerful business strategy, organizations can unlock their full potential and drive success in today’s landscape.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Angel round raised $120,000, or 100% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $1,357,118 to $1,357,118, a 1x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 73 (+3 over 90 days) and market heat at 75 (+8).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
